title: OCI FinOps - Customer Monthly Spend
description: Per-customer spend tracking. Compartment-level customers roll up by compartment within their tenancy; whole-tenancy customers roll up at the tenancy level.

list.name: tenancy
list.label: Tenancy
list.query: SELECT alias FROM tenancies WHERE is_active ORDER BY alias

list.name: customer
list.label: Customer
list.query: SELECT group_name FROM (SELECT group_name FROM customer_groups WHERE sub_team IS NULL UNION SELECT group_name FROM tenancy_customers WHERE sub_team IS NULL) c ORDER BY group_name

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(total_billed_cost) AS "MTD Spend" FROM mv_daily_cost_by_group g LEFT JOIN tenancy_customers tc ON tc.tenancy_alias = g.tenancy_alias WHERE COALESCE(tc.group_name, g.group_name) = '${customer}' AND cost_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND ('${tenancy:raw}' = '' OR g.tenancy_alias IN ($tenancy))

SELECT SUM(total_billed_cost) AS "Previous Month" FROM mv_daily_cost_by_group g LEFT JOIN tenancy_customers tc ON tc.tenancy_alias = g.tenancy_alias WHERE COALESCE(tc.group_name, g.group_name) = '${customer}' AND cost_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '1 month' AND cost_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND ('${tenancy:raw}' = '' OR g.tenancy_alias IN ($tenancy))

WITH cur AS ( SELECT SUM(total_billed_cost) AS spend FROM mv_daily_cost_by_group g LEFT JOIN tenancy_customers tc ON tc.tenancy_alias = g.tenancy_alias WHERE COALESCE(tc.group_name, g.group_name) = '${customer}' AND cost_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND ('${tenancy:raw}' = '' OR g.tenancy_alias IN ($tenancy)) ), prev AS ( SELECT SUM(total_billed_cost) AS spend FROM mv_daily_cost_by_group g LEFT JOIN tenancy_customers tc ON tc.tenancy_alias = g.tenancy_alias WHERE COALESCE(tc.group_name, g.group_name) = '${customer}' AND cost_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '1 month' AND cost_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND ('${tenancy:raw}' = '' OR g.tenancy_alias IN ($tenancy)) ) SELECT CASE WHEN prev.spend > 0 THEN ROUND(((cur.spend - prev.spend) / prev.spend) * 100, 1) ELSE NULL END AS "MoM Change %" FROM cur, prev

SELECT cost_date AS time, SUM(total_billed_cost) AS "Billed Cost" FROM mv_daily_cost_by_group g LEFT JOIN tenancy_customers tc ON tc.tenancy_alias = g.tenancy_alias WHERE COALESCE(tc.group_name, g.group_name) = '${customer}' AND cost_date >= CURRENT_DATE - interval '90 days' AND ('${tenancy:raw}' = '' OR g.tenancy_alias IN ($tenancy)) GROUP BY cost_date ORDER BY cost_date

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', cost_date), 'YYYY-MM') AS "Month", SUM(total_billed_cost) AS "Billed Cost" FROM mv_daily_cost_by_group g LEFT JOIN tenancy_customers tc ON tc.tenancy_alias = g.tenancy_alias WHERE COALESCE(tc.group_name, g.group_name) = '${customer}' AND cost_date >= CURRENT_DATE - interval '12 months' AND ('${tenancy:raw}' = '' OR g.tenancy_alias IN ($tenancy)) GROUP BY date_trunc('month', cost_date) ORDER BY date_trunc('month', cost_date)

SELECT servicename AS "Service", SUM(total_billed_cost) AS "Billed Cost" FROM mv_daily_cost_by_group g LEFT JOIN tenancy_customers tc ON tc.tenancy_alias = g.tenancy_alias WHERE COALESCE(tc.group_name, g.group_name) = '${customer}' AND cost_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND ('${tenancy:raw}' = '' OR g.tenancy_alias IN ($tenancy)) GROUP BY servicename ORDER BY SUM(total_billed_cost) DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT servicename AS "Service", servicecategory AS "Category", SUM(total_billed_cost) AS "Billed Cost", SUM(total_effective_cost) AS "Effective Cost", SUM(total_list_cost) AS "List Cost", CASE WHEN SUM(total_list_cost) > 0 THEN ROUND((1 - SUM(total_billed_cost) / SUM(total_list_cost)) * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS "Discount %" FROM mv_daily_cost_by_group g LEFT JOIN tenancy_customers tc ON tc.tenancy_alias = g.tenancy_alias WHERE COALESCE(tc.group_name, g.group_name) = '${customer}' AND cost_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND ('${tenancy:raw}' = '' OR g.tenancy_alias IN ($tenancy)) GROUP BY servicename, servicecategory ORDER BY SUM(total_billed_cost) DESC
